ratio_scope: Certified lower bound divided by the enclosed 16-spin gap; not an infinite-chain ratio
model: H = sum over a ring of 2L spins of (1+delta) S.S inside each two-spin cell plus (1-delta) S.S between neighboring cells
frame: Certificates are for the rotated frame U'HU, U = (1 x J)^{x L}, J = [0 1; -1 0] on the second spin of every cell (rotated_model, frame_identity)
validity: every even L >= n0 = 4 cells (N = 2L spins divisible by 4, N >= 8)
negative_scope: For delta=1/5,3/20,1/10 and n0=2,4 cells (n0=2 at every delta), every beta>0 fails the doubling recurrence of certified_gap_bound. This does not imply gaplessness or exclude other methods, other seed theorems or larger rings.
